# Kiii² — Korean financial PII detection

Release **{{VERSION}}** contains **{{COUNT}} synthetic documents** annotated with a regulation-grounded, 36-category taxonomy, surface-form transformations T0–T3, multiple subjects and varied document lengths. No real customer records were used as source material. Synthetic values can coincidentally match real names or identifiers and must not be used to contact or identify people.

## Status and intended use

This is an automatically validated research release candidate, **not a fully human-adjudicated gold standard**. Human review, annotation agreement and final release licensing remain pending. Use for PII span extraction and masking research; results do not establish legal compliance or production safety. Taxonomy mappings express benchmark design choices, not legal advice.

All 1,440 documents form one evaluation split, named `test` for Hugging Face compatibility. There is no train, validation or development split within this benchmark. Do not train, fine-tune, choose thresholds or tune prompts on these documents. Use separate, non-overlapping pilot documents for engineering and prompt calibration, and freeze settings before benchmark inference. Only frozen pretrained extractors, prompted LLMs and rule-based systems are in the evaluation scope; benchmark-trained baselines are excluded.

Independent generation seeds and exact-text deduplication are checked. Shared templates, repeated synthetic names, canonical values and near-duplicates may remain; no claim of complete semantic independence is made. Generator development involved inspection of generated examples, so this is not a previously unseen human-authored test distribution.

## Fields

- `doc_id`, `text`: unique document ID and original Unicode text.
- `spans`: list of category, tier, kind, policy, exact surface, canonical value, start/end offsets, entity/subject identifiers, subject role, transformations and optional fragment metadata. Offsets are Python Unicode code-point indices, start inclusive and end exclusive; do not normalize text before scoring.
- `hard_negatives`: offsets, surface and type for annotated non-PII examples.
- `subjects`: document-local subject IDs and roles. Entity and subject IDs are only meaningful within a document.
- `generator`: model, prompt/profile version and transport provenance, stripped of local paths and provider request IDs.
- `doc_type`, `variation_level`, `num_subjects`, `context_len_bucket`, `planned_context_len_bucket`, `pre_masked`, `taxonomy_version`, `generation_seed`, `release_version`.
- `n_tokens`: generation-time **character-based estimate**, not a model tokenizer count. Measure actual prompt tokens for capacity checks. Length buckets are approximate. See `statistics.json` for actual distributions; planned and actual lengths may differ.

## Construction and limitations

The language model composes templates; code fills synthetic identifiers and transformations and derives offsets. GPT-6 Astra and GLM-5.2 generated text. Failed examples may be regenerated by another generator; published provenance records the selected output. Generator models must be flagged and excluded from headline detector comparisons. Generator allocation differs by length, particularly in the second stage; stratify results by generator and length.

Automatic checks cover schema, offsets/surfaces, category consistency, supported checksum/format checks, subject references, length rules and exact duplicate text. These checks do not prove exhaustive PII annotation, faithful consultation boundaries, realism or zero unintended personal data. Some post-2020 identifier formats have different checksum semantics.

## Loading and reproducibility

```python
from datasets import load_dataset

# After upload, replace both values with the actual repository and commit SHA.
dataset = load_dataset("OWNER/REPO", revision="COMMIT_SHA")
test = dataset["test"]

# Before upload, load the same files locally:
local = load_dataset("json", data_files={
    "test": "data/test.jsonl",
})
```

The release manifest stores SHA-256 checksums of upload files. Pin the Hub commit, release version, evaluation prompt and tokenizer revisions. Full-context targeted extraction and local-window ablations should use identical gold-blind output partitions and include failed/truncated calls in end-to-end metrics. Entity-all-mentions recall is not entity-linking accuracy, and character coverage is not risk-weighted recall.
